name: Jonas Platt
bioAdditions: Eldest son of Zephaniah Platt (1704-1778) and Hannah Saxton. Married Temperance, daughter of Ebenezer Smith 1st (son of Richard 2d); died 1775 aged 44; she died 12 Mar 1813. Their son Col. Richard Platt was aide to Gen. Montgomery on the Quebec expedition; their daughter Elizabeth married Rev. David Schuyler Bogart (S1). Not to be confused with Judge Jonas Platt (1769-1834), whose Morse portrait is on Commons; that Jonas was a son of the Plattsburgh founder.
